title: The Male CEO and the Female Assistant: Evaluation and Mitigation of Gender Biases in Text-To-Image Generation of Dual Subjects
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The benchmark measures gender bias related to occupations and organizational power, not religious bias.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion/faith; its findings are focused on gender bias in text-to-image models.
